newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Prices slip, trade slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Prices slip, trade slow.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids were mostly down on Friday, partly reflecting a modest decline in futures on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange.

Dealers said farmer selling remained slow as producers remembered last year when those who sold in January, as nearby spring wheat futures were around $3.65/3.75, missed out on a subsequent price rise to a peak of more than $5.50 in mid-July.
"I think they are taking the wrong stance this year," one dealer said, noting a similar rally appeared very unlikely this year with supplies appearing to be plentiful.
March spring wheat on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange closed 1-1/2 cents lower at $3.80-1/2 a bushel.
